trainingProgram.title: Mandatory & Statutory Training for Support Workers (UK)
trainingProgram.description: Comprehensive training program covering all mandatory and statutory requirements for support workers in the UK.

modules.title: Health & Safety Awareness
modules.description: Understand workplace hazards, risk assessments, and health & safety principles.

modules.title: Fire Safety Awareness & Evacuation Procedures
modules.description: Learn fire risk awareness, evacuation procedures, and fire extinguisher use.

modules.title: Manual Handling / Moving & Handling
modules.description: Safe handling of people and objects to prevent injuries.

modules.title: Infection Prevention & Control
modules.description: Prevent infection spread, proper hand hygiene, PPE usage.

modules.title: Safeguarding Adults
modules.description: Recognize abuse, report concerns, and understand safeguarding frameworks.

modules.title: Safeguarding Children
modules.description: Protect children from harm and understand statutory duties.

modules.title: Equality, Diversity & Human Rights
modules.description: Promote inclusivity, respect diversity, and understand legal frameworks.

modules.title: Basic Life Support / First Aid / Resuscitation
modules.description: Respond to emergencies, perform CPR, and basic first aid.

modules.title: Information Governance & Data Protection
modules.description: GDPR, confidentiality, and secure handling of personal data.

modules.title: Food Hygiene / Food Safety
modules.description: Prevent foodborne illnesses, hygiene practices, and safe handling.

modules.title: COSHH (Control of Substances Hazardous to Health)
modules.description: Identify hazardous substances and use safety measures.

modules.title: Preventing Radicalisation ("Prevent" duty)
modules.description: Identify signs of radicalisation and report concerns.

modules.title: Mental Capacity Act (MCA) & DoLS
modules.description: Understand decision-making capacity and legal safeguards.

modules.title: Consent & Record Keeping
modules.description: Ensure informed consent and accurate record-keeping.

modules.title: Lone Working & Personal Safety
modules.description: Minimise risks for lone workers and understand personal safety strategies.

modules.title: Medication Awareness / Safe Handling of Medicines
modules.description: Safe administration, storage, and recording of medicines.

modules.title: Mental Health Awareness
modules.description: Recognize stress, wellbeing, and resilience strategies.

modules.title: Dementia Awareness
modules.description: Understand dementia, communication, and care strategies.

modules.title: Learning Disability Awareness
modules.description: Support individuals with learning disabilities, communication, and care techniques.
